title: 手不变脚来调
description: 成人保持两手大把手不动，低位缓慢调整双脚位置。

art_direction.medium: editorial geometric illustration with credible adult proportions
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult keeps both hands on the same large holds while adjusting one foot sideways on a low vertical wall. The other foot stays secure and the torso shifts only slightly to preserve balance. The new foothold is broad, close, and easy to reach, with shoes just above the mat. A wide view includes the whole stable triangle of supporting contacts, avoiding diagrams, arrows, or multiple copies of the person. Use dry-brush acrylic illustration with blocky forms, textured edge transitions, and a clear gray-green, persimmon, and cream palette.
